notes.title: Situation TARFU Version 6!
notes.content: [p]Version 6 is here and it includes some neat little additions topping off all of the original content and making room for the new modes coming in version 7![/p][p][/p][p]Here's what's new:[/p][list][*][p]The long awaited Leaderboard is here! it shows off the Top 10 highest scores around the world (you must turn on leaderboard uploading in the settings)[/p][/*][*][p]Speaking of settings I've finally added an FPS cap option with presets like unlimited, 120, 60 and 30.[/p][/*][*][p]You may notice some hidden buttons and what not, that's stuff for version 7 coming soon.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Although this update may seem small it is really just here to set the game up for the new stuff, there's lots to look forward to in the next update such as, a new story mode with new controls, a new versus mode utilizing the characters new attacks from the story mode, voice acted cutscenes and a new Bios tab.[/p][p]All that will be a free update so I hope you look forward to it and play it when it drops![/p]

notes.title: Version 5.1 Minor Tweaks
notes.content:
Version 5.1 is here and adds a couple of things

- For every 10 Wacky Peaches collected you'll now get a 1up!
- A little 1up animation plays when a 1up is earned
- Added what level you are currently on to the UI to help out with the achievement
- Other internal changes that impacted performance (minorly but still)
- Removed 60FPS cap, frames are now unlimited (FPS cap settings will be added in version 6)

notes.title: Version 5 is here!
notes.content:
Version 4 wasnt really the last!

It's time for a new update 1 year later! 
Here's what's new:
-ACHIEVEMENTS!!!
-New peaches added to single player
-Updated backgrounds
-Updated font for all text
-New Extras menu featuring Bios and History tabs
-Touched up character stats
-Faster ladder climbing
-Versus results screen tallies faster
-Rewrote all bios
-And some other minor changes

This is just a little return to game development update sorta topping off quirks with the game before I fully move on to new things!

Thanks for playing Situation TARFU and stay tuned for more TARFU in the future!

-Kenzie S.

notes.title: The final update
notes.content:
The final Situation TARFU update is here, 

New art, an options menu and a new character can all be found in Situation TARFU version 4!

Now with this done CrazyLegends Studios is moving onto something new and BIG!

Thank you for playing [b]Situation TARFU[/b]
